Zero new v0.1.3-attributable regressions across the full offline suite (4017 passed; all 21 failed + 3 errors confirmed, by name, against the same pre-existing catalog established earlier in this session). Required generators for every deliverable are ready (some pending fresh data only, never pending a code change). Lifecycle remains MODEL 0 (nothing implemented since Step 4A). The one fresh six-ticker production run is the only remaining substantive QA data step -- no further code change is needed before it.

issue_1_six_ticker_regression_results.evidence: comqutor_alpha/regression/regression_report_v3.py exists, 10/10 tests pass. build_regression_report_v3_entry() requires an EXPLICIT selected_run_id and takes the caller's own already-loaded run_audit/artifact_manifest for that exact run -- it never auto-selects or guesses a run, structurally preventing accidental staleness/mixing.
